headline: 161 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Old Trails Fire in WA, threatening 23,677 structures.

active_threats.name: Old Trails
active_threats.narrative: The Old Trails Fire in Spokane County, WA has burned 3,556 acres and is 43% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **23,677 structures threatened**. 513 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 19 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. A wind shift is expected during the window — the kind of transition that is hardest for a 3 km forecast model to time and place precisely. Forecast wind (W) is not currently aligned toward Airway Heights city, the nearest community of size, 3 miles away.

wind.windninja_applicability: PARTIAL - snapshot before & after the shift; cannot model the transition

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over OR, WA: Kennewick city, Pasco city, Walla Walla city, Hermiston city, and West Richland city and 8 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch and SPC's **Elevated** fire-weather category. USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 28% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
